question: According to the Planning Commission of India (2011-12), what is the percentage of the population below the poverty line in Chandigarh?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**21.8%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chandigarh's Poverty Rate according to the Planning Commission of India **(2011-12) was 21.81**%.
 
• This percentage reflects the** portion of the population living below the poverty line,** which is a measure of economic disparity.
 
• **T****he Planning Commission, now replaced by the NITI Aayog**, played a crucial role in assessing and reporting poverty levels across India.
 
• **Chandigarh, being a union territory** and a city, has a relatively lower poverty rate compared to some states, indicating a higher standard of living and better economic conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Concept
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Planning Commission**
 An institution in the Government of India, which formulated India's Five-Year Plans, among other functions. It was established in 1950 and replaced by the NITI Aayog in 2015.
 
 

 **NITI Aayog**
 The National Institution for Transforming India, established to achieve sustainable development goals with cooperative federalism. It took over the role of the Planning Commission in 2015.
 
 

 **Poverty Line**
 A benchmark or threshold income level, below which individuals or families are considered to be living in poverty, lacking the means to meet basic living needs.
 
 

 **Economic Disparity**
 The difference in wealth and income between different groups or populations within a society.
 
 

 **Five-Year Plans**
 Centralized and integrated national economic programs, which were developed, executed, and monitored by the Planning Commission of India.
